item.description: New: Name your places, the folders where files may go, in Settings or as Tikana first opens, each with a line on what it holds. Better: Waiting says why nothing waits, with the button that puts it right. Adding a place or saving your key asks Claude at once. Fixed: With folders and a key but no places, Tikana did nothing and never said why. Check for Updates… now says when a newer version is ready, and the update window comes to the front.
